How It Works page - Public page explaining the weekly leasing process with step-by-step visual guide
Fleet Preview page - Public page showing available vehicle categories/types without sensitive pricin
Requirements page - Public page displaying customer eligibility requirements for leasing (age, insur
FAQ page - Public frequently asked questions page with expandable/collapsible answers covering commo
Contact/Inquiry page - Public contact form with fields for name, phone/email, desired vehicle, timef
Terms of Service page - Public legal page with complete terms and conditions for the leasing service
Privacy Policy page - Public legal page with privacy policy explaining data collection and usage pra
GPS/Telematics Disclosure page - Public legal page disclosing the existence and purpose of vehicle t
Inquiry form submission - Customer can submit inquiry form and system stores inquiry record in datab
Inquiry auto-response email - System sends automatic email acknowledgement via Resend when inquiry i
Admin inquiry dashboard - Admin can view list of submitted inquiries with customer details and times
Keycloak OIDC integration - Authentication via existing Keycloak instance using OIDC protocol
Customer signup flow - New users can register through Keycloak and customer role is assigned
JWT token validation - Backend validates JWT tokens from Keycloak on protected endpoints
RBAC enforcement - Role-based access control enforces admin/ops/customer permissions on all routes
Logout functionality - Users can securely logout and session is invalidated
Customer dashboard - Authenticated customers see personalized dashboard with summary of their accoun
Customer profile page - Customers can view and update their profile information
Customer insurance upload - Customers can upload driver insurance documentation securely
Insurance file validation - System validates insurance uploads (file type, size, magic bytes)
Insurance storage in MinIO - Insurance documents stored in private MinIO bucket (not PostgreSQL)
Customer insurance status view - Customers see insurance verification status without accessing the a
Admin insurance verification - Admin can view insurance documents and approve/reject verification
Insurance access audit logging - Every insurance document access is logged in audit trail
Insurance break-glass access - Admin must provide reason for accessing insurance documents
Customer vehicle request - Approved customers can request a vehicle for leasing
Vehicle request restriction - Only approved customers can request vehicles
Customer assigned vehicle view - Customers see their assigned vehicle details after admin assignment
Customer notifications center - Customers see in-app notifications for important events
Customer incident report submission - Customers can submit incident reports with photos and details
Incident photo storage - Incident photos stored in MinIO private bucket with signed URL access
Customer weekly invoices view - Customers see list of their weekly invoices with status
Customer payment proof upload - Customers can upload payment proof screenshot for verification
Payment proof storage - Payment screenshots stored in MinIO private bucket
Payment verification pending notification - System sends 48-hour verification notice via Resend emai
Payment duplicate detection - System detects and flags duplicate payment proof uploads
Admin dashboard overview - Admin dashboard shows key metrics and summary statistics
Admin customer management - Admin can view and manage customer list
Admin vehicle CRUD - Admin can create, read, update, and delete vehicles
Vehicle availability status - Admin can set and update vehicle availability states
Vehicle condition report - Admin can create and view vehicle condition reports
Admin vehicle assignment - Admin assigns available vehicles to approved customers creating LeaseCont
Admin tracker device management - Admin can manage GPS tracker inventory
Tracker vehicle assignment - Admin assigns tracker devices to vehicles
Tracker assignment audit - Tracker assignments are recorded in audit log
Weekly invoice generation - System generates weekly invoices for active lease contracts on schedule
Admin weekly invoices view - Admin can view all weekly invoices with filters
Admin payment verification - Admin can approve or reject payment proof submissions
Payment rejection workflow - Admin can reject payment with reason
Payment verification audit - Payment approvals/rejections logged in audit trail
Admin maintenance scheduling - Admin can create maintenance schedules for vehicles
Monthly service tracking - Admin can record completed monthly service events
Due date reminder notifications - System sends due date reminders to customers via email and in-app
Late payment detection - Day 1 after due date marks invoice as Late and applies late fee
Delinquency case creation - Late payments automatically create DelinquencyCase for tracking
Admin delinquency queue - Admin can view and manage delinquency cases
Day 2 escalation notice - System sends escalation notice on Day 2 of delinquency
Recovery workflow compliance gate - Admin must complete compliance authorization before tow/recovery
Recovery action creation - Admin creates RecoveryAction after compliance authorization
Lease termination on recovery - System terminates lease when recovery initiated
Permanent ban on recovery - System creates BanRecord and permanently bans customer
Admin incident triage - Admin can view and manage customer incident reports
Admin audit log viewer - Admin can search and view comprehensive audit logs
Admin settings page - Admin can configure system settings
VehicleConditionReport entity model - Condition reports linked to vehicles
BanRecord entity model - Permanent ban tracking
